protocol.corner: all fixed force jets are uniformly O(q^N) for every N; q<=2*tau+4*abs(z)^(1/D); all terminal force jets flat at origin
protocol.derivative_orders: force C^m needs A C^(m+3), B C^(m+2), p0 C^(m+1); uniform next time jet reserves one additional order
protocol.diagnostics: 9 exact localization vector components at 3 positive viscosities; 12 nonzero omission controls; 98 Leibniz and 49 terminal factorial controls; exact compact polynomial energy integrals
protocol.domain: same current realization restricted to the existing late observation cylinder; cutoff support closure lies inside its domain
protocol.energy: E(t)+2*integral_0^t D <= (integral_0^t ||f||_2)^2; separately sup E<=F(1)^2 and total D<=F(1)^2/2; do not add separate extrema with same budget
protocol.extension: sigma=t-1; f_plus=sum chi0(b_j*sigma)*sigma^j/j!*F_j; b0=2; increasing b_j=2^n_j; one sequence for a+m<=floor(j/2)
protocol.force_support: K x [1-tau0,3/2]; smooth compact force on R3 x (0,infinity), zero initial datum
protocol.growth: on inherited protected core and localization plateau: u_theta >= (e0/2)*tau^(-A), relative to retained core lemma
protocol.localization: c=chi_r(r^2)*chi_z(z)*chi_t(t); u=curl(c*A)+c*B=c*u0+grad(c) cross A; p=c*p0; full fixed gauge
protocol.pressure: -Delta p=partial_i partial_j(u_i*u_j)-div f; force need not be divergence free
protocol.scope: compact smooth global force and preterminal energy relative to retained exact-core and finite analytic lemmas; no global comparison or unconditional blow-up
protocol.unchanged_parameters: Md64; unit viscosity; same h,N,positive lambda,width C_setup^-20,roots,geometry,labels,cutoff sequences and pressure gauge

admissibility_and_conditional_scope.force: f in C_c^infinity(R3 x (0,infinity)), support subset K x [1-tau0,3/2]

current_axisymmetric_localization.cutoff: c=chi_r(r^2)*chi_z(z)*chi_t(t), compact axisymmetric support and unit plateau near (0,1)
current_axisymmetric_localization.field: u=curl(c*A)+c*B=c*u0+d; p=c*p0; d=grad c cross A
current_axisymmetric_localization.pressure: same complete p0 with both Pi1/Pi2 and all wave/mean differences; -Delta p=DD(u tensor u)-div f

global_uniform_terminal_force_jets.corner_bound: for all alpha,j,N: |D_x^alpha partial_t^j f_minus|<=C*(tau+|z|^(1/D))^N near corner
global_uniform_terminal_force_jets.trace: F_j=lim_(t->1-) partial_t^j f_minus uniformly on R3; F_j in C_c^infinity(K), every spatial jet at origin zero
